comment_box: The Pennsylvania Pro-Life Federation, representing tens of thousands of people and nearly 40 local county-based chapters throughout the Commonwealth of Pennsylvania, writes in support of excluding abortion and abortion counseling from the benefits package at the Department of Veterans Affairs. The vast majority of Americans do not want their hard-earned tax dollars to pay for abortion, which is the taking of an innocent, unrepeatable human life and causes a woman to grieve the death of her child. This proposed rule is important for the health and safety of pregnant women and their children and we applaud it.
